[EN] Try training the way the Highwatch Guards train.
[ES] Intenta entrenar de la forma en que entrenan los Highwatch Guards.

[EN] Would you like to try a tougher workout regimen?
Come train with the Highwatch Guards!
If you give it a try, I'll give you a little reward as an incentive."I will."
[ES] ¿Te gustaría probar un régimen de entrenamiento más duro?
¡Ven a entrenar con los Highwatch Guards!
Si lo intentas, te daré una pequeña recompensa como incentivo."I will."

[EN] How was it?

Here is your reward."It was a good workout."
[ES] ¿Cómo te fue?

Aquí tienes tu recompensa."It was a good workout."
